description: This file defines the main client-side component for the explore page of a career navigation application. It manages UI state, fetches filter options, handles search logic, and renders the page layout including search bar, filters, and role results.

methods.name: fetchOptions
methods.description: Fetches available industries and skills options from the API on component mount.

methods.name: handleManualSearch
methods.description: Performs a search request based on the selected filters and updates search results state.
